name: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc.
blurb: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. is a leading provider of go-to-market intelligence and sales enablement software. The company offers a cloud-based platform that helps businesses identify, target, and engage potential customers through comprehensive B2B contact and company data. ZoomInfo serves a wide range of industries and is recognized as a key player in the sales intelligence market.
recent: In the past 30 days, ZoomInfo's stock has experienced volatility amid broader tech market trends. The company reported its quarterly earnings on February 10, 2025, with results that met analyst expectations, though forward guidance was cautious. Analysts have maintained mixed ratings, with some citing competitive pressures in the data analytics space.
